# openwrt_firewall_forwarding (Resource)

Manages an OpenWrt firewall forwarding rule (zone-to-zone traffic).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dest` (String) Destination zone name.
- `src` (String) Source zone name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: firewall/<src>_<dest>.
